subject: Request to lift PO requirement for EdgeForge trial onboarding
messages:
From: Sam Reed <sam.reed@edgeforge.com>
To: Irene Choi <irene.choi@redwood.com>
Date: Mon, 28 Sep 2026 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: Trial onboarding - PO requirement question

Hi Irene,

Thanks again for the product walkthrough last week — the team at EdgeForge is excited to kick off the 30-day trial. Quick question on our side: our procurement team typically doesn't issue a PO for short pilot engagements under $5k. Can Redwood make an exception so we can get started while legal completes the MSA?

I've attached the trial SOW and W-9 — total estimated spend for the trial is $3,800. If you need anything else (invoices, reference PO number, or a charge card payment), we can accommodate.

Attachments: edgeforge-trial-sow.pdf (pdf), edgeforge-w9.pdf (pdf)

Best,
Sam Reed
Head of Partnerships | EdgeForge Inc.
O: 415-555-0192
From: Irene Choi <irene.choi@redwood.com>
To: Procurement Team <procurement@redwood.com>
Cc: Aditya Rao <aditya.rao@redwood.com>, Monica Patel <monica.patel@redwood.com>, Markus Klein <markus.klein@redwood.com>
Date: Mon, 28 Sep 2026 09:35:00 -07:00
Subject: Fwd: Trial onboarding - PO requirement question

Folks — forwarding a pilot onboarding request from EdgeForge. They want a temporary carveout from the PO mandate for a <$5k trial.

Key points:
- Trial value: $3,800 (SOW attached)
- External already sent W-9 and is willing to sign SOW/Invoice terms
- MSA still in review; goal is to begin trial next week

Can procurement/finance sign off on a time-limited no-PO path (invoice-only) if we get the intake form + W-9 + an approved SOW? Please advise required evidence and any limits. If we need legal sign-off on contract language, loop them in.

Thanks — Irene
Irene Choi
Senior Solutions Engineer | Redwood Inference
From: Aditya Rao <aditya.rao@redwood.com>
To: Irene Choi <irene.choi@redwood.com>, Monica Patel <monica.patel@redwood.com>, Markus Klein <markus.klein@redwood.com>
Date: Mon, 28 Sep 2026 11:02:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Fwd: Trial onboarding - PO requirement question

Thanks for the ping, Irene.

Procurement side checklist for a temporary no-PO onboarding (pilot under $5k):
1) Completed vendor intake form (vendor-intake-form.pdf)
2) W-9 on file (edgeforge-w9.pdf)
3) SOW or invoice that lists exact scope and amount (edgeforge-trial-sow.pdf)
4) Finance (Monica) to confirm available payment routing (invoice-only or card)
5) Time-limited approval: 30 days from first invoice; require follow-up before any additional spend
6) Risk notes: new vendor + no MSA in place — legal should confirm minimal acceptable terms (indemnity/data treatment)

If we get #1-3 and Finance okays invoice routing, Procurement can approve a one-off temporary carveout. I'll draft the approval memo and add compliance notes.

--Aditya
Aditya Rao
Procurement Manager | Redwood Inference
From: Monica Patel <monica.patel@redwood.com>
To: Aditya Rao <aditya.rao@redwood.com>, Irene Choi <irene.choi@redwood.com>, Markus Klein <markus.klein@redwood.com>
Date: Mon, 28 Sep 2026 12:20:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Fwd: Trial onboarding - PO requirement question

Irene / Aditya — Finance can support invoice-only routing for this pilot under the following conditions:
- Vendor intake form + W-9 received and validated
- Total pilot spend <= $5,000 and paid within Net 30 of invoice date
- Transaction will be routed to marketing trial budget (GL 4301) and ownership assigned to Solutions (Irene)
- No automatic renewals or rollovers; any extension requires normal PO flow and budget approval

If legal flags any insurance/indemnity issues, we will hold payments until their disposition. Otherwise Finance signs off.

Monica Patel
Senior Accountant | Redwood Inference
From: Markus Klein <markus.klein@redwood.com>
To: Irene Choi <irene.choi@redwood.com>, Aditya Rao <aditya.rao@redwood.com>, Monica Patel <monica.patel@redwood.com>
Date: Tue, 29 Sep 2026 09:14:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Fwd: Trial onboarding - PO requirement question

Quick legal note: we can proceed with invoice-only for a time-limited pilot, but require the following minimal contractual guardrails before payment is released:
- Signed SOW (scope, term, fee) or a signed acknowledgement from the vendor that the invoice reflects the trial SOW
- Standard data processing addendum (DPA) acceptance if EdgeForge will process customer data during the trial; if they won't, a written confirmation is sufficient
- No broad indemnities or long-tail warranties in the SOW for a trial; if the SOW contains unusual clauses, send to Legal for redline

If those conditions are met we will not require the full MSA before the pilot starts. I'll be available for an expedited review if they return the signed SOW today.

—Markus Klein
Associate General Counsel | Redwood Inference
From: Irene Choi <irene.choi@redwood.com>
To: Sam Reed <sam.reed@edgeforge.com>
Cc: Aditya Rao <aditya.rao@redwood.com>, Monica Patel <monica.patel@redwood.com>, Markus Klein <markus.klein@redwood.com>
Date: Wed, 30 Sep 2026 14:05:00 -07:00
Subject: RE: Trial onboarding - PO requirement question

Hi Sam — good news, we can move forward with the pilot start next week under a temporary invoice-only path. To confirm next steps and evidence we need from EdgeForge by end of day Friday:

1) Completed vendor intake form (attached) — please return signed
2) Signed SOW or signed invoice acknowledgement (edgeforge-trial-sow.pdf)
3) W-9 (we already have yours on file and attached)
4) Confirm whether EdgeForge will process any Redwood customer data during the trial. If yes, please sign our DPA (link below) or state you will not process customer data

Once we receive 1–3 and the DPA/confirmation, Procurement + Finance will issue temporary approval for invoice-only payment for the trial amount ($3,800). This approval is good for 30 days and does not change our normal PO policy for ongoing engagements.

DocuSign link for SOW: https://app.docusign.com/edgeforge/MSA-signature
DPA: https://drive.redwood.com/dpa-template

I'll coordinate kickoff once we have the documents. Thanks — excited to get EdgeForge running.

Best,
Irene Choi
Senior Solutions Engineer | Redwood Inference
